profile.summary: Haynes Family of Programs is a nonprofit in La Verne, California that provides mental health, residential and education services for children and families. Its S.T.A.R. Academy is a California Department of Education approved Non-Public Agency that provides special education services, such as academic support, therapy and transition services, to students whose needs cannot be met in their home districts.
